claim_boundary: This boundary records a ROADMAP-level candidate-workspace fidelity criteria map for language/build runners, candidate abstraction, marker and materialization policy, embedded evaluators, codebase scale, mutation-mode/operator provenance, prompt-example-copy guards, cross-file consistency, initial-pool/static-binary handling, and workspace resume integrity. It does not claim configured language/build runners, flexible solution abstraction APIs, candidate-embedded evaluator contracts, realistic codebase fixtures, adaptive mutation-mode selection, mutation-operator family provenance, semantic prompt-example-copy detection, cross-file consistency benchmark evidence, initial-pool divergence benchmark evidence, static/binary replay policy, topology resume replay proof, or owner review signoff.
